items.html:
Plays for Ventura Cricket Club in the Southern California Cricket Association, Southwest Region, California, Played in three ICC Trophy Tournaments: Kenya in 1994, Malaysia in 1997 and Canada, 2001. Played for USA in West Indies Cricket Board[WICB] Red Stripe Bowl in Jamaica, 1999 also played for US team in ICC Six Nations Challenge in UAE 2004. Member of Team USA since 1993.
USACA (September 2004)
